items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 2:1
items.html: In the Ibur of the Gadlut of ZA, when he raises his AHAP with him to Aba and Ima, also the aspect of the bodies of Malchut is attached to the AHAP of ZA, and she is discerned as her first MAN. Therefore, in this Ibur, two statures of ten Sefirot then emerge: one upon his MAN, and one upon the MAN of the Nukva. And since the Nukva is not fit to receive there her stature of ten Sefirot, because they are of the upper ones, therefore ZA receives her stature in deposit, in the secret of the firstborn taking a double portion. And afterward, when ZA descends from there and comes to his place, he returns to her the stature of ten Sefirot that he received on her behalf, little by little, in the manner of the degree, as is known.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 2:2
items.html: (To the question) And it is found that as long as Malchut has not received her deposit from ZA, her stature of ten Sefirot is still included in ZA. Behold, prior to the growth of Malchut, her nine Sefirot are found included in ZA. (Item 3).
